title: Optimizing Cloud Resource Allocation Using AI Techniques for eCommerce Industry
content:
The eCommerce industry's explosive growth has highlighted how important it is to allocate cloud resources effectively in order to handle workloads that are unpredictable and dynamic. Traditional methods of allocating resources frequently lead to either over-provisioning, which wastes resources, or under-provisioning, which causes performance bottlenecks. To overcome these obstacles, this paper presents an AI-driven optimization strategy based on reinforcement learning (RL), neural networks (NN), and genetic algorithms (GA). The combined AI approaches optimize settings for different eCommerce workloads, forecast workload demands, and dynamically modify resources.
	Simulated cloud environments with situations such as seasonal spikes in sales traffic were used to test the suggested approach. In comparison to static allocation methods, the results demonstrated a 27% improvement in performance stability and a 35% reduction in operational expenditures. The RL component successfully managed periods of high demand with an 85% success rate, lowering latency by 22% and increasing resource efficiency by 42%. In order to avoid service interruptions and financial losses, a case study using the fictitious eCommerce platform ShopEase showed 95% accuracy in forecasting a 400% spike in traffic during a mock Black Friday event.
These results demonstrate how AI has the ability to completely transform cloud resource management by making it possible to create scalable, reasonably priced, and adaptable infrastructure that is ideal for the eCommerce industry.
